howto.what: 当常规执行方式反复失败时，Claude 会先将脚本写入文件，再用 run_shell 执行，从而获得更清晰的错误信息和更好的调试能力。
howto.when: 当 shell_agent 或 execute_code_sandbox 持续出错、超时，或你需要调试内联代码时触发。

howto.what_en: When standard execution fails repeatedly, Claude writes the script to a file first, then executes it via run_shell, providing clearer error messages and easier debugging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when shell_agent or execute_code_sandbox consistently fails, errors, or times out, or when debugging inline code is difficult.
